Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the Order Form.

Looping in Kim (legal) and Ben (sales) so we can get redlines back to you with an operational playbook for asset custody and the minimum evidence list. Quick summary of what we'll propose:
- Asset custody: Redwood will host marketing assets during the pilot and return or escrow final approved assets at the end of the engagement; we will not store source-only files (design masters) unless explicitly agreed.
- Logo use: Redwood will use provided logo assets only for the agreed announcement and will not sublicense. All usages will reference Orchid as the customer and include pre-approval for any variations.
- Evidence: minimal list = audit log extract (date/time/user), staged screenshot(s) with watermark, and signed marketing consent from an authorized Orchid rep.

Attached: preliminary redline of the Order Form and a short evidence checklist we use operationally. Kim — can you review the proposed publicity annex language (I attached msa_annex_publicity_v2_redline.pdf) and flag any legal risks or required edits?

If acceptable, Ben and I will consolidate and send a single redline to your procurement and legal teams.

Best,

Subject: Re: Draft order form & publicity/evidence questions

Laura — thanks for the summary. I reviewed the draft annex and the Order Form redline. High-level legal notes below (included in pdf redline):

1) Asset custody / escrow
- We can accept Redwood hosting marketing assets during the engagement. Add express language that (a) assets are solely marketing collateral ("Marketing Assets" defined), (b) Redwood provides an audited transfer package on termination (files + verification log), and (c) Redwood will retain assets for 90 days post-termination unless Orchid requests longer retention with separate SOW.

2) Logo use / sublicensing
- Tighten publicity clause: Redwood may use customer logos and quotes only with prior written approval for each instance. We should limit global sublicensing language and add an express prohibition on sublicensing to third parties without Orchid's consent.

3) Evidence & auditability
- The evidence checklist is fine but needs an evidentiary standard: audit log extracts must include event timestamps and user IDs; screenshots must include a visible watermark with date; and a named signatory line is required on any marketing consent.

4) Press release timing and embargo
- Add a 5-business-day approval window prior to any public release and allow Orchid to request a brief redaction window for legal/regulatory review.

5) Indemnity/attribution nuance
- Replace open-ended "use at Redwood's discretion" language with a narrow attribution clause: Redwood may publish case studies with Orchid's approval; Redwood will not use Orchid trademarks outside the agreed announcement.

I've attached the annotated annex (msa_annex_publicity_v2_redline.pdf) and an updated Order Form redline that includes the retention and escrow language. Ben — operationally, we'll need the contact at Orchid who can provide the named signatory and the artifact to confirm staging screenshots; Laura, can you confirm the contact?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Draft order form & publicity/evidence questions

Hi Maya — appreciate the quick turnaround. Per Kim's review, attached are our consolidated redlines (Order Form + Annex) and the evidence checklist we need to operationalize a publicity opt-in. Summary of agreed points we are proposing:

- Redwood hosts marketing assets during the pilot; final approved assets returned as an audited transfer package within 30 days of termination unless Orchid elects 90-day retention.
- Redwood will request written approval for each use of Orchid's logo/quote; no sublicensing without consent.
- Evidence required for publicity opt-in: audit log extract, dated watermarked screenshots, and a signed consent by the named Orchid signatory.
- 5-business-day approval window prior to public release; Orchid can request redaction or delay for regulatory/legal reasons within that window.

Next steps:
1) Maya/Orchid Legal: please confirm the named signatory (name/title/email) we should reference in the Order Form and whether Orchid prefers 30 or 90 day default retention.
2) Ben: once we have the signatory and retention choice, can you push the redline to procurement and coordinate signature logistics (DocuSign link included above)?

If all looks good, we'd like to get signature this week so we can schedule the announcement workflow and asset handoff.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
